governance_principles: Declared capability is not treated as proof of operational capability
Deterministic evaluation where an objective test is available
No invented values for evidence that cannot be reliably observed
Human oversight at consequential action boundaries
Public observation without bypassing access controls

applicable_frameworks.relevance: AI transparency and governance obligations may apply depending on the AI systems, role and use case involved.
Processing of personal data where applicable.
Electronic communications and storage/access technologies where applicable.

narrative_summary.purpose: Synthesis and explanation of already-observed evidence.

human_oversight.subject_of_observation: Publicly accessible web properties and their observable machine-readable interfaces.

consequential_agent_actions.principle: Actions involving payment, contractual commitment, irreversible external effects or other consequential operations should require explicit authorization where the applicable capability supports such actions.

observation_governance.principle: The presence of a declaration, file, endpoint or agent card is not by itself evidence that the associated capability is operational.

machine_web_governance.agent_discovery: Observation may identify publicly declared agents and capabilities.
machine_web_governance.delegation: Delegation should occur only where an agent exposes an appropriate machine contract and applicable policy permits the action.
machine_web_governance.orchestration: Multi-agent orchestration should preserve task identity, participating-agent identity, execution state and available provenance.
machine_web_governance.human_approval: Human approval boundaries should be preserved when declared by the participating capability or required by applicable policy.
machine_web_governance.artifact_provenance: Transferred artifacts should preserve available provenance and integrity metadata.
machine_web_governance.auditability: Where available, agent participation, actions, state transitions and artifacts should be traceable.

categories.condition: When a user initiates an observation.
Only when voluntarily provided or required for a requested service.
As generated by the service infrastructure.

processor_categories: AI model provider where narrative synthesis is used
Payment provider where payment functionality is used
Email delivery provider where email functionality is used
data_handling.international_transfers: Handled under applicable GDPR transfer mechanisms where required.

change_control.integrity_scope: Byte-level consistency of designated public artifacts.
